description: Real NFL salary cap + RFA tender amounts per season. Values written verbatim into SLRI.SCAD / SLRI.RFA1..4 of a Madden franchise save to seed an era-correct cap economy. Source: OvertheCap.com / NFLPA historical CBA records, cross-referenced with the M08 PS2 fresh-save fixture (2007 entry confirmed byte-identical).

fields.cap: League salary cap for the regular season (dollars). Written to SLRI.SCAD.
fields.franchiseTag: Approximate franchise tag for the most-expensive position (QB) that year (dollars). Written to SLRI.SMAD.
fields.rfa: Restricted free agent tender amounts (dollars) at the 4 ascending tiers: low / second-round / first-round / original-round. Written to SLRI.RFA1..RFA4 in order.

notes: 2010 was an uncapped year (CBA expiration). We use a synthetic ~$123M figure so Madden's cap math has a non-zero value to display.

2021 cap dipped due to COVID-19 reduced revenues; first time the cap decreased year-over-year. Madden's engine never produces a decrease via simulation, but writing the lower value is mechanically safe (32-bit field).
2026 values are TBD until late February of that year; placeholder = projected upper end of estimates.
